Financial Sector Seeks Tax Cuts and Support in Budget

Players in India's capital markets and the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector are urging the government to implement tax reductions and provide financial support in the upcoming Budget for FY28. Specifically, capital market participants are calling for a decrease in capital gains tax and transaction tax, including Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) and Securities Transaction Tax (STT). The BFSI sector is pitching for general tax relief and is also requesting refinancing support, with Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) seeking funding assistance.
